title: Production platform observations
context: Beyond what a Resource Graph export shows, the platform team watches three things Azure itself reports: Advisor reliability findings, service retirements and the baseline initiative assignment.
decision: No high-impact reliability recommendation stays open on production; no production resource depends on a service retiring within 180 days; the baseline initiative stays assigned at the subscription.
decisionDrivers: Advisor is the cheapest early warning the platform has
A retirement found late is a forced migration
consequences: Retirement notices open a review proposal
assumptions: Advisor and policy results are handed in from Azure MCP Server 3.0.0

claims.statement: No high-impact reliability recommendation is open on production
No production resource depends on a service retiring within 180 days
The baseline initiative is assigned at the subscription
